rows.name: Deadly
rows.description: Vast acid bath. 1d5+1 Damage each Round (ignores TB and Armour). If Heavy: breaks environmental seals after 1d10+2 hours.

rows.name: Corrosive
rows.description: Poisonous and deadly on contact. Difficult (-10) Toughness Test each Round or suffer 1d5 Damage (ignores Armour and TB). Continued exposure causes suffocation (RT Core p.261).

rows.name: Toxic
rows.description: Poisonous gases. Breathing requires Challenging (+0) Toughness Test each Round to avoid 1 Damage (ignoring TB and Armour). Continued exposure causes suffocation.

rows.name: Tainted
rows.description: Can sustain human life but stained by trace toxins. No direct effect on Explorers but influences long-term colonisation viability.

rows.name: Pure
rows.description: Entirely safe for humans and most common life forms to breathe.
